name: sample_overlay
description: Render one frame of an overlay JSX to PNG via Puppeteer; optionally return per-element bounding-box and overflow measurements as JSON.

input.description: Absolute path to the overlay JSX file

output.description: PNG file at the requested output path. In --measure mode, stdout is a JSON object with pngPath and measurements keys instead of a bare path.

params.name: overlay
params.description: Absolute path to the JSX overlay file

params.name: duration
params.description: Overlay length in frames, for the `duration` global. Omit to preview steady state — end-of-life fades and anything driven by `frame / duration` will not animate without it.

params.name: fps
params.description: Frame rate for the `fps` global. Pass the project's settings.fps — spring() is tuned in wall-clock time, so sampling a 60fps project at the 30 default shows springs settling twice as fast as they actually will.

params.name: props
params.description: Props JSON string passed to the overlay component

params.name: google-fonts
params.description: Google Fonts to load: a list such as ["DM Serif Display", "DM Sans:wght@700"], or a comma list. A family that does not load is a warning; the sample still renders with its fallback font.

params.name: measure
params.description: When set, return per-element bounding-box and overflow data as inline JSON on stdout
